page.notes: The scan is too small and low in resolution to read reliably. Only the layout (a single dense column of Latin text, with a running head and page number at the top) can be made out. The body lines cannot be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. A rescan at higher resolution is needed for an accurate transcription.
